title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated user could create and deliver an Entity…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated attacker can craft and deliver a malicious Entity Analysis dashboard link to a user. If the user opens the link, attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands may execute with the user's permissions, potentially exposing or modifying data accessible to that user. This vulnerability arises because entity values from the link are inserted into SPL searches without proper escaping. Exploitation requires user interaction via phishing, and the attacker cannot exploit it without tricking a user into opening the link.
